subject: General Science

questions.q: What is the defining characteristic of an unsaturated carbon compound?
options: It contains at least one double or triple bond between carbon atoms.
All carbon atoms are linked by only single bonds.
It always contains a functional group with oxygen.
questions.explain: Unsaturated carbon compounds contain one or more double or triple covalent bonds between adjacent carbon atoms (alkenes and alkynes).
